score.description:
Numeric match score from [0..1]. 0 means no match and 1 means exact match.

Thus an input of "Open" would have coverage 0.5 for "OpenType" and 0.29 for "OpenTypewriter".

groups.description:
The parts of the input string that were matched explicitly and implicitly by the pattern. Parts that were matched
implicitly are prefixed with an asterisk.
E.g. for an input of "OT" nameMatches will be `["O", "*pen", "T", "*ype"]`;
and an input of "OpenTy" it will be `["OpenTy", "*pe"]`.

The concatenation of all the parts (minus the asterisks) will be the same as input string.
